ui.title: Atalaia mode editor
ui.test_sending: Loading the mode into the simulator…
ui.test_running: {name} is running in the simulator with {boxes} boxes.
ui.test_running_errors: {name} is running in the simulator, with script errors: see Problems.
ui.test_failed: The simulator could not load this mode; its game goes on as it was. See Problems.
ui.test_offline: The simulator does not answer ({error}). Is python -m atalaia_sim serve running?
ui.no_field: No controller blocks: this mode has no field.lua.
ui.replace: Replace the blocks in the editor?
ui.bad_file: This is not a file saved by the Atalaia mode editor.
ui.intro: Build a game mode from blocks. The editor writes the Lua scripts and the manifest a mode is made of; run them in the simulator, then share them as a mode folder.
ui.mode_author: Copyright holder (for the files' licence headers)
ui.mode_hint: The settings a GM can change are blocks too: "setting …" in the Settings category; so are the GM commands.
ui.kind_modifier: Modifier (runs alongside a main mode on the same box)
ui.kind_role: Role package (its own boxes, next to any game)
ui.roles_hint: Every box with one of these roles runs the same box script. A role needs the inputs the script reacts to, unless you choose its own.
ui.role_auto: the inputs the script reacts to
ui.screens_hint: The mode's own screen files (assets/screens/<name>.yaml); the boxes' toolbox offers them with the box's own screens.
ui.bad_screen: Not a screen file: {name}. A screen is assets/screens/<name>.yaml, at most 4096 bytes, with "template: <name>".

blocks.state_node: box memory (kept through a power loss)
blocks.state_node_tip: The values a box remembers in this game. Each one gets a starting value.
blocks.state_field_tip: The values the field controller remembers in this game. Each one gets a starting value.
blocks.state_item_tip: A value to remember, and its value when the game starts.
blocks.state_get_tip: A value from the box's or the controller's memory.
blocks.state_set_tip: Changes a value in the box's or the controller's memory.
blocks.on_tip: Runs the blocks inside when this happens.
blocks.on_custom_tip: Runs the blocks inside when an event of this type arrives (for example a custom event of your mode).
blocks.ev_release: a team lets go of its button
blocks.ev_keypad: a key is pressed on the keypad
blocks.ev_set_owner: the GM sets the box's owner
blocks.ev_rebooted: the box is back after a power loss
blocks.ev_gps: the prop's GPS has a position
blocks.ev_node_rebooted: a box is back after a power loss
blocks.event_value_tip: A value the event carries. Only inside a "when" block.
blocks.event_value_custom_tip: Any value the event carries, by its name. Only inside a "when" block.
blocks.emit_tip: Tells every box, the controller and the GM console that something happened. Use a standard event type, or x.<you>.<name> for one of your own.
blocks.pair_tip: A named value: the event's, the screen's or the command's data.
blocks.every_tip: Runs the blocks inside again and again, this many seconds apart.
blocks.every_as_tip: Repeats the blocks inside and keeps the timer in a variable, so that it can be stopped.
blocks.after_tip: Runs the blocks inside once, after this many seconds.
blocks.after_as_tip: Runs the blocks inside once, later, and keeps the timer in a variable, so that it can be stopped.
blocks.cancel_tip: Stops a timer kept in a variable. The variable must hold a timer.
blocks.win_tip: Ends the game with this team as the winner.
blocks.finish_tip: Ends the game. The reason is a short word, e.g. time or bomb.
blocks.teams_tip: A list of the game's team names, in order.
blocks.return_tip: Leaves the "when" block or the function: the blocks after it do not run.
blocks.score_add_tip: Gives a team points (a whole number; less than zero takes points away). The reason is a short word shown with the points.
blocks.score_get_tip: A team's points on this box (or on the controller).
blocks.screen_tip: Shows one of the mode's screens (assets/screens/<name>.yaml) with these values.
blocks.sound_tip: Plays one of the box's sounds, e.g. captured, armed or explosion.
blocks.team_display_tip: Shows a team's colour on the box's lights (none turns them off).
blocks.param_tip: The value of one of the mode's settings, as the GM chose it for this game.
blocks.param_declare_tip: A setting the GM can change before the game. It goes into mode.yaml.
blocks.rand_tip: A random whole number, the same in a replay of the game.
blocks.log_tip: Writes a line in the box's log (the simulator shows it).
blocks.idiv_tip: Divides and drops what is after the decimal point.
blocks.field_ids_tip: A list of the numbers of the boxes that play this role.
blocks.field_owner_tip: The team that last captured this box (nothing if none).
blocks.field_common_owner_tip: The team that holds all of these boxes, or nothing if they are not all one team's.
blocks.field_send_tip: Sends a command to one box: set_owner, message, or mode (the mode's own commands).
blocks.field_score_tip: A team's points across the whole field.
blocks.problem_event_outside: "event's …" is outside a "when" block, where there is no event.
blocks.problem_param_undeclared: The setting "{name}" is used but has no "setting … is a …" block.
blocks.problem_param_default: The setting "{name}" has a default that does not fit its type or range.
blocks.problem_state_undeclared: "{name}" is not in the memory block: give it a starting value there.
blocks.problem_bad_id: The mode id must look like org.club.my-mode (lower case, at least one dot).
blocks.problem_points_integer: Points must be a whole number.
blocks.geo_distance_tip: The distance in metres between two positions (latitude, longitude).
blocks.geo_in_zone_tip: Whether a position (latitude, longitude) is inside a zone; its edge counts as inside.
blocks.geo_circle_tip: A round zone: its centre (latitude, longitude) and its radius in metres.
blocks.geo_polygon_tip: A zone of any shape: 3 to 32 corners, in order around it.
blocks.geo_point_tip: One corner of an area: latitude and longitude.
blocks.event_has_position_tip: Whether the event carries a latitude and a longitude (a GPS without a fix sends none).
blocks.command_declare_tip: A button the GM console shows on the boxes of these roles (names separated by commas). It goes into mode.yaml.
blocks.on_command_tip: Runs the blocks inside when the GM presses this command, or when the controller script sends it.
blocks.field_send_mode: send the mode command %1 to box %2
blocks.field_send_mode_tip: Sends one of the mode's own commands to a box, which gets it in "when the mode command … arrives".
blocks.problem_screen_unknown: The screen "{name}" is neither one of the box's nor one of the mode's screen files (Mode tab).
blocks.problem_no_role: The mode needs at least one role.
blocks.problem_bad_role: The role name "{name}" must be lower case letters, digits and _.
blocks.problem_role_input_unhandled: The role "{name}" needs an input the box script never reacts to.
blocks.problem_role_no_input: The role "{name}" needs none of the inputs the box script reacts to.
blocks.problem_role_unknown: "{name}" is not one of the mode's roles (Mode tab).
blocks.problem_command_twice: The GM command "{name}" is declared twice.
blocks.problem_command_unhandled: The GM command "{name}" has no "when the mode command … arrives" block.
